jobs: The camera glides slowly forward over the valley at sunrise. Villagers swing axes at trees, carry baskets and raise the timber frame of a house; chimney smoke drifts, birds fly over the castle. Audio: soft rising orchestral strings, birdsong, distant axe chops. A deep, calm male narrator says: "Every empire begins with a single village." Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.

The camera tracks low beside four armies marching toward the viewer, banners whipping in the wind, horses tossing their heads, dust rising in the low sun. Audio: pounding war drums, brass horns, thousands of marching feet. A deep male narrator says: "Four dynasties rise." Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.

The trebuchet throws its burning boulder, which arcs into the castle wall and explodes in fire and stone; the battering ram swings into the gate; knights and spearmen clash below. Audio: epic choir and full orchestra, thunderous impacts, clashing steel. A deep male narrator says: "Only one will rule." Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.

A slow, majestic push toward the castle on the hill at sunset; glowing embers drift upward through the frame, clouds roll slowly, the sky darkens to gold. Audio: a final triumphant orchestral swell ending on a deep cinematic boom. No speech. Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.

The longbowmen draw together and loose a great volley; hundreds of arrows rise into the grey sky and arc toward the distant army; blue lion banners ripple. Audio: creaking bows, the whoosh of a storm of arrows, heroic orchestral strings. A deep male narrator says: "The Britons. Masters of the longbow." Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.

The Frankish knights charge toward the camera, lances lowered, horses thundering, clods of earth flying, green fleur-de-lis banners streaming. Audio: thundering hooves, clanking armour, a bold brass fanfare. A deep male narrator says: "The Franks. Lords of the cavalry charge." Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.

Greek fire pours from the walls and blazes across the water; the cataphracts' horses stamp; purple double-eagle banners wave over the golden city as the camera rises toward the domes. Audio: roaring flames, a solemn Byzantine choir, war drums. A deep male narrator says: "The Byzantines. The walls that never fell." Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.

The soldiers on the Great Wall raise their repeating crossbows and shoot thin bolts toward distant enemies off screen; the red dragon banners ripple in the wind; the paper lanterns stay hanging on their poles; the camera drifts slowly along the wall as mist rolls over the mountains. Nothing flies toward the camera. Audio: rapid crossbow clacks, deep war drums, a sweeping erhu and orchestra. A deep male narrator says: "The Chinese. An empire without end." Keep the painterly look of the image. No text on screen, no subtitles.
